label: Act

notes.note: T1: overlay checked; finger, three knuckles, bent thumb, open wrist, ring and rays match; sheet strokes run heavier than W
T1 review fix: ring concentric with the fingertip; outer rays mirrored about the middle ray

corrections.what: Gave the three knuckles one radius (7.565 px) at one 15.13 px pitch, so each knuckle's right side is the next one's left side and the last becomes the hand's right edge; each keeps its own drawn height (tops y 67.6, 73.4 and 80.8)
corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats. Knuckle fits give r 7.5 to 7.7 and centre pitches of 15.1 and 15.0 px.

corrections.what: Drew the fingertip as a true semicircle (r 8.36) on two straight parallel sides, x 34.57 and 51.3
corrections.why: DR-03 true circles and straight lines. The tip fits r 8.56 on the sheet; the sides are plumb.

corrections.what: Drew the control ring as one true circle arc of r 27.02, open at the bottom between 44.5 and 133 deg
corrections.why: DR-03 true circles; the ring fits a circle within 0.17 px rms on both sheets.

corrections.what: Built the thumb from its two fitted straight sides (62.7 and 52.2 deg) joined by a hook arc of r 7.55 tangent to both
corrections.why: DR-03. The hook fits r 7.55 with 0.28 px rms; the tangent construction keeps both sides where the sheet puts them.

corrections.what: Moved the finger's right side and the first knuckle's left side 0.05 px right (x 51.3)
corrections.why: At the measured 51.25 the stroke edges fell on pixel midlines and the 1x bake check flipped edge pixels (IoU 0.986); the nudge is invisible. Under the revised bake metric the nudge is no longer needed; it stays because the ring's centre (42.94, 38.34) is set from this fingertip.

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at the set line weight W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. This icon is the heaviest of its row: median 6.04 px, the ring 6.2 to 6.3 px. That is why the silhouette IoU (0.87) and ink ratio (0.90) sit low while the centrelines match.

corrections.what: Review fix: made the ring concentric with the fingertip, centre (42.94, 38.34) (measured centre 41.15, 37.8), same radius and gap; the ring moves 1.79 px right and 0.54 px down
corrections.why: Identity-mark finish, by the reviewer's call: the 1.8 px offset between ring and fingertip on the sheet is a raster drift, and concentric reads as the intended 'press' target.

corrections.what: Review fix: mirrored the upper and lower rays about the middle ray (y 39.06) on one fan from (57.6, 39.06) at +-31.8 deg, inner radius 28.3, length 11.4: upper (81.65, 24.15) to (91.34, 18.14), lower (81.65, 53.97) to (91.34, 59.98); the middle ray stays
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry, by the reviewer's call. The sheet's outer rays measure -30 and 33.6 deg and sit unevenly about the middle ray; the moves are under 1.2 px.

source_notes: Pillar mark (DR-04). Kept: the long upright index finger inside the ring, its right side ending open at y 83.4 below the first knuckle; the knuckle count of three, stepping down to the right; the bent thumb hooking up and back to meet the finger's left side at y 98.5, with the finger's side running on to a small point at y 103.1; both wrist ends open (x 36.2 and 86.3 at y 141). The ring is concentric with the fingertip and the outer rays mirror about the middle one (review fixes). Red is the ring and the three rays; the finger and hand stay black; both sheets agree.
